connection.certificate.level.critical: The certificate expires in two weeks or less. Renew it now with “Repair the connection”, or the panel stops working.
connection.certificate.level.expired: The certificate has expired, so the panel can no longer reach Microsoft. Repair the connection now.
connection.certificate.level.warning: The certificate expires soon. Renew it in good time with “Repair the connection”.
connection.certificate.pending: A new certificate is waiting to be put in use. Thumbprint: {thumbprint}.
connection.lead: How the panel is connected to your Microsoft 365 tenant, and whether that connection is healthy.
connection.loadError: The connection could not be loaded
connection.noAccess: You need the right to manage the connection to see this page.
connection.notConnected: The panel is not connected to a tenant yet. Finish the setup wizard first.
connection.proof.check_v4: Configuration compared with what is expected
connection.proofDetail.check_v4: Secrets: {passwordCredentials}. Certificates not from the panel: {foreignKeyCredentials}. Owners: {owners}.
connection.proofDetail.foreignWarning: The application has credentials or owners that the panel did not add. Review them in Microsoft Entra: whoever holds them can act with the permissions of the panel.
connection.proofDetail.notChecked: Not checked. This needs a fresh sign-in at Microsoft.
connection.proofEmpty: There is no proof yet. Verify the connection first.
connection.repair.lead: Repair brings the configuration in Microsoft Entra back to what the panel expects. It only adds what is missing and reports what is extra; it never removes permissions by itself.
connection.repair.manualNote: This panel was set up by hand. Repair by hand too: compare the checklist with Microsoft Entra, then verify.
connection.repair.needsSignIn: Repairing needs a fresh sign-in at Microsoft by an administrator.
connection.repair.renewNote: A new certificate is added next to the old one and tested. Only then is the old one removed.
connection.repair.stepUpNote: You are asked to confirm with a new sign-in first.
connection.repair.title: Repair the connection
connection.secrets.app_key_invalid: APP_KEY does not match the data on the volume. Check that it is the key that was used before, and restart the container.
connection.secrets.app_key_missing: APP_KEY is not set. Set APP_KEY or APP_KEY_FILE and restart the container; signing in is unavailable until then.
connection.secrets.certificate_unreadabl: The stored certificate cannot be read. Restore the data volume from a backup, or set up the connection again.
connection.secrets.no_certificate: There is no certificate yet. Finish the setup wizard.
connection.secrets.ok: The key and the certificate work.
connection.title: Connection
